root_cause: Privilege-escalation asymmetry (found on T-0637): publishing an agent_instruction (which becomes the live LLM agent's SYSTEM PROMPT) required a WEAKER right than saving its draft. saveDraft (PUT /api/agents/:id/instruction, agents.ts::handleSetAgentInstruction) gates on scoped mgmt_object:agent/update over the OWNING agent (holdsAgentMgmtUpdate + isNarrowerOrEqual). But POST /api/artifacts/:id/promote promote='agent_instruction' (artifacts.ts::defaultCheckTierPromoteGrant) required only the GENERIC, agent-unbound mgmt_object:tier_promote/transition grant that grant/registry/app publishing shares. Attack: admin A drafts agent X's instruction; admin B, holding only generic tier_promote and NO authority over X, publishes it -> B installs X's live system prompt.
fix_approach: Scoped the promote path for artifact_table='agent_instruction' ONLY to require the SAME authority as saveDraft: mgmt_object:agent/update over the OWNING agent (resolved from the instruction row's employee_id -> position -> department, org-root fallback mirroring agents.ts::loadAgentOrgScope). This REPLACES the generic tier_promote gate for agent_instruction (not AND) so authority == saveDraft (author can publish; a pure agent/update holder needs no separate tier_promote). All OTHER artifact types (grant/registry_def/application) keep the generic tier_promote gate untouched. Wired through the existing ArtifactAuthzDeps.checkTierPromoteGrant seam by widening its signature with a ctx:{artifactTable,artifactId} param (existing zero-arg test stubs stay assignable); the default impl branches on ctx.artifactTable.

src/http/artifacts.ts (agent_instruction promote gated on scoped agent/update via shared predicate; loadOwningAgentOrgScope + checkAgentInstructionAuthority added; ctx passed to gate)
